name: avatar
need: Show a person or an entity as a picture, initials or an icon, alone or as a group with "+N"

--ds-avatar-size.description: an avatar (and the account's avatar of the app frame) at size md, 8px more or less per size step

--ds-avatar-bg.description: an avatar without a hue: its fill and its initials or icon

--ds-avatar-color.description: an avatar without a hue: its fill and its initials or icon

--ds-avatar-square-radius.description: `.ds-avatar--square` (at most a quarter of the side, times `--ds-shape`)

--ds-avatar-edge-color.description: the edge ring between stacked avatars, around a status dot, a badge and the activity ring: the ground the avatar lies on

--ds-avatar-ring-color.default: `--ds-primary` (a `.ds-tone-*` class on the avatar: the tone)

labExempt.DS.avatar.initials: a pure function of a name: no motion
labExempt.DS.avatar.hue: a pure function of a name: no motion
labExempt.DS.avatar.create: writes initials, a hue class and a label: no motion
labExempt.DS.avatar.group: hides avatars past the maximum and writes the menu of the rest: the menu opens through DS.overlay, whose entrance the menu's own entries play

ripple..ds-avatar: a ripple host clips while a ripple is inside, which would cut the status dot and the badge on the corner; an interactive avatar presses through its state layer until each ripple clips itself (plans/after-2.0.md)
